title: The Carriage Studio
description: Just steps from the beautiful Cumberland River, The Carriage Studio offers the perfect mix of vintage charm and modern comfort. Originally built in 1935 as a carriage house, this thoughtfully updated studio now serves as a stylish and cozy retreat for travelers looking to experience both the quiet and the culture of East Nashville. Located below our main home, you won’t share any areas with us, giving you the comfort and privacy of your own serene home base. We look forward to hosting you!
